name: CaptureKit - Full Page Screenshot & Annotate
description: Full page screenshot tool: capture whole pages or scroll, annotate, auto-redact on-device, and save as PNG, JPEG, PDF or SVG.

capture-scroll.description: Scroll capture (assign a shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts)

capture-element.description: Element picker capture (assign a shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts)

capture-scroll-element.description: Scrollable-element capture (assign a shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts)

capture-desktop.description: Screenshot a window or your screen (opens the picker; assign a shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts)

record-pause.description: Pause / resume the recording (assign a shortcut at chrome://extensions/shortcuts)

record-toggle.description: Start / stop recording the tab (assign a shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts)
